intent: When the agent starts a long command in the background and waits for it, the session's page shows nothing new for many minutes (session 2026-11-21T19-03-38-792Z: 17 minutes with no line while "pnpm test" ran), so I can't tell it from a stuck session. And a session whose agent ends its turn with a background command still running stays "Working" forever. Show on the page that the agent is waiting on a background command, which one, and for how long. Find why a turn that ends with a background command still running never ends the session, and end it properly. Add tests that fail without the fixes, and open a pull request with a short title and body.
title: Background command status on session page
